Senior Product Manager

About UptimeAI:

UptimeAI is leading the way in predictive analytics and AI-driven solutions to optimize operational uptime and reduce downtime for industrial and enterprise clients. Our innovative platform harnesses cutting-edge data science to deliver actionable insights, ensuring maximum efficiency and reliability.

UptimeAI uniquely combines Artificial Intelligence with Subject Matter Knowledge from 200+ years of cumulative experience to explain interrelations across upstream/downstream equipment, adapt to changes, identify problems, and give prescriptive diagnosis like a human expert would. Recently receiving a funding round led by WestBridge Capital, UptimeAI is prime for global expansion.

Title: Sr. Product Manager

Location: US (Remote)

Team: Product Management

Reports to: Director of Product Management

Role Summary

Lead the strategy and delivery of operator-assist AI agents that reduce cognitive load, accelerate decision-making, and improve reliability/throughput. You’ll partner with Data Science/ML, Engineering, Design, and SMEs to ship safe, measurable AI capabilities grounded in plant workflows and industrial data.

What you’ll build

  • Ask & Explain Agents – NL answers with citations to plant data/knowledge.

  • Detect & Triage Agents – Prioritize signals, cluster issues, surface “what first” with rationale.

  • Diagnose & Advise Agents – Hypotheses, likely causes, and safe next steps with evidence trails.

  • Optimize & Plan Agents – Suggestions for run-windows, guardrails, or maintenance planning.

  • Automate & Document Agents – Draft shift notes/reports, pre-fill tickets—always human-in-the-loop.

  • Learn & Improve Agents – Capture operator feedback and post-event learnings under governance.

  • Principles: explainability, role-based access, auditability, human confirmation before actions.

Responsibilities

  • Translate operator/reliability jobs-to-be-done into agent capabilities, success criteria, and safe workflows.

  • Partner with DS/ML on retrieval & evaluation (offline/online), quality bars (task success, time-to-answer), and safety (hallucination gating, RBAC/ABAC, audit).

  • Define data needs across time-series, events/alarms, asset hierarchies, procedures/docs; guide pragmatic integrations (historians, SCADA/MES, CMMS/EAM).

  • Drive pilots via feature flags, scale what works, publish internal playbooks and customer-approved case studies.

  • Support GTM with value narratives (noise↓, MTTR↓, throughput/energy↑) without disclosing feature roadmaps.

Qualification

Required

  • 7+ years in Product Management, including shipping AI/ML or GenAI experiences (assistants, retrieval/RAG, agentic workflows) in production.

  • Industrial/process domain fluency in Oil & Gas, Power Generation, or Chemicals (reliability, predictive maintenance, maintenance operations).

  • Data/platform literacy: time-series historians, events/alarms, asset models; familiarity with SCADA/MES and CMMS/EAM concepts.

  • Proven collaboration with DS/ML on prompts/retrieval design, evaluation datasets, online experiments, and safety/guardrails.

  • Enterprise SaaS delivery: discovery → PRD → beta → GA; adoption instrumentation and outcome metrics.

  • Excellent communication; track record driving cross-functional alignment with Eng/DS/Design/GTM and customers.

Preferred

  • Experience with digital twins, 2D/3D/P&IDs, or asset-centric search.

  • Global rollout exposure (data residency, access controls, regulatory contexts).

  • Pricing/packaging for AI add-ons and ROI storytelling (case studies, value calculators).

  • Public speaking/thought leadership (industry forums) and/or published content.

  • MBA or advanced technical degree (Engineering, Data Science, Operations Research)
